summary: Complete testing of Referral + Wallet System. Backend: 23/23 tests passed covering all wallet endpoints, referral code generation/verification, admin wallet views, topup validation. Frontend: All UI components verified including wallet page, admin wallets page, register referral code input, sidebar navigation links.

issues: UX gap: When operator has 0 balance but wallet_suspended=false (new operator), no warning banner is shown. The suspended banner only shows when wallet_suspended=true, and the low balance banner only shows when 100 <= balance < 500. An operator with balance 0 who hasn't been auto-suspended yet sees no visual alert (only the card turns red). Consider adding a banner for isCritical && !wallet_suspended scenario.

action_items: Minor UX: Consider showing a critical balance warning banner even when wallet_suspended=false but balance < 100, to proactively alert new operators.
critical_code_review_comments: wallet.py deduct_wallet: Suspension logic only triggers when a deduction drops balance below 100. New operators start with 0 balance but are never auto-suspended unless they go through a deduction — this is correct behavior, but may need a startup check or cron to handle pre-existing zero-balance operators.

auth.py referral code generation uses range(6) for primary code, but fallback uses range(8) chars — minor inconsistency (both valid but slightly different). Regex in tests accepts 6-8 chars accordingly.

Razorpay topup create-order returns 500 when no gateway is configured — the error message 'Payment gateway not configured. Contact admin.' is shown via toast, which is good UX. This is expected behavior per spec.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing test operators (operator1, operator2) and admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wallet & Referral system is fully working. Both operator1 (REF-8HVOO1) and operator2 (registered with REF-8HVOO1 code) are set up. No transactions yet (balances are 0.00). Razorpay topup will return 500 (no gateway configured - expected). Next: Test invoice generation deducting Rs.10 from wallet, balance < 500 reminder cron, and balance < 100 suspension cron when those features are added.
